_meta.note: Deep spec sheets keyed by equipment slug. Merged client-side onto live listings by the detail page. OEM base-unit specs; actual machine may vary with options/attachments. Operational fields (year, hours, unit #) are '-' until known.

caterpillar-d4k2-bulldozer.overview: The Caterpillar D4K2 is a compact crawler dozer built for grading, backfilling, fine-finish work and land clearing. A 92-hp Cat C4.4 ACERT diesel paired with a hydrostatic transmission and low-ground-pressure undercarriage lets it maneuver on tight or soft sites while still moving serious material.
caterpillar-d4k2-bulldozer.configNote: Values are OEM specs for base configurations (XL / LGP); the actual machine may vary with options and attachments.

cat-310-excavator-11-5-tons.overview: The Cat 310 is a 10-ton-class mini hydraulic excavator built for utility, site development, and light foundation work where a full-size machine is too big. It pairs a 69.5 hp Cat C3.3B engine with a stick-mounted dozer blade for backfilling and grading, and offers strong dig depth and reach for its compact footprint. A practical, easy-to-transport digger for tight urban and residential jobs.

rows.v: U.S. EPA Tier 4 Final / EU Stage V

cat-310-excavator-11-5-tons.configNote: Specifications are OEM base-unit figures; the actual unit may vary with options, stick length, counterweight, and attachments.
cat-310-excavator-11-5-tons.source: Cat 310 Mini Hydraulic Excavator Specalog (AEHQ8156), Caterpillar.com product page, and Construction Equipment Guide (https://www.constructionequipmentguide.com/charts/mini-excavators/caterpillar/310/30752124); teknoxgroup.com/fileadmin/user_upload/310.pdf

komatsu-pc210-lc-20-ton-excavator.overview: The Komatsu PC210LC-11 is a 20-ton-class long-crawler hydraulic excavator suited to mass excavation, utility trenching, site prep, and heavy digging. Its 165 hp Tier 4 Final engine and load-sensing hydraulics deliver strong cycle times and fuel efficiency, while the LC undercarriage adds stability and reach. A workhorse size class for general contractors and earthmoving crews.
komatsu-pc210-lc-20-ton-excavator.configNote: Specifications are OEM base-unit figures; the actual unit may vary with options, arm length, shoe width, counterweight, and attachments.
komatsu-pc210-lc-20-ton-excavator.source: RitchieSpecs Komatsu PC210LC-11 (https://www.ritchiespecs.com/model/komatsu-pc210lc-11-hydraulic-excavator); Komatsu PC210/LC-11 brochure (komatsu.eu / komatsu.com.au)

cat-305-5e2.overview: The Cat 305.5E2 CR is a 5.5-ton compact-radius (reduced tail-swing) mini excavator for landscaping, utility, and confined-site work close to walls and traffic. It offers an integrated dozer blade, adjustable auxiliary hydraulics for attachments, and low ground pressure for sensitive surfaces. A versatile, trailer-towable digger that balances reach with a tight working envelope.
cat-305-5e2.configNote: Specifications are OEM base-unit figures; the actual unit may vary with options, canopy vs. cab, stick length, and attachments. Dig depth reflects the long-stick configuration.
cat-305-5e2.source: RitchieSpecs Caterpillar 305.5E2 CR (https://www.ritchiespecs.com/model/caterpillar-305-5e2-cr-tier-4-interim-mini-excavator); Cat 303.5E2-305.5E2 CR Specalog (holtcat.com); Cat 305.5E2 CR brochure (teknoxgroup.com)

hitachi-zx225uslc-5b-20-ton.overview: The Hitachi ZX225USLC-5B is a 20-ton-class reduced-tail-swing (ultra-short) hydraulic excavator that keeps the counterweight within or near the track width for work along roadways, structures, and tight lots. It combines full-size digging force and reach with a compact rotating envelope, on a long (LC) undercarriage for stability. Ideal for urban excavation, utilities, and road work.
hitachi-zx225uslc-5b-20-ton.configNote: Specifications are OEM base-unit figures; the actual unit may vary with options, arm length, shoe width, and attachments. Weight and bucket figures are from the ZX225US-5B series spec sheet; several dig/hydraulic figures reflect the ZX225USLC (ZAXIS-5 US) base unit and may vary slightly on the -5B.
hitachi-zx225uslc-5b-20-ton.source: RitchieSpecs Hitachi ZX225USLC (https://www.ritchiespecs.com/model/hitachi-zx225uslc-hydraulic-excavator); Hitachi ZX225US-5B / ZX225USLC-5B ZAXIS-5 series spec sheet (cableprice.co.nz, hitachicm.com.au)

hitachi-zx135us-13-5-ton.overview: The Hitachi ZX135US-6 is a 13.5-ton-class reduced-tail-swing hydraulic excavator that delivers near-conventional digging performance with a compact rotating radius for road, utility, and confined-site work. Powered by a Tier 4 Final Isuzu engine, it offers smooth multi-function hydraulics and low emissions. A strong mid-size choice where space is tight but reach and force still matter.
hitachi-zx135us-13-5-ton.configNote: Specifications are OEM base-unit figures; the actual unit may vary with options, arm length, shoe width, and attachments.
hitachi-zx135us-13-5-ton.source: RitchieSpecs Hitachi ZX135US-6 (https://www.ritchiespecs.com/model/hitachi-zx135us-6-hydraulic-excavator); Hitachi Construction Machinery ZX135US-6 product page (hitachicm.com/us); Construction Equipment Guide

26k-36k-heavy-forklift.overview: A purpose-built heavy-duty diesel forklift for lumber, steel, concrete and heavy cargo yards. Reinforced masts, oversized rollers and chain anchors let it cycle long, wide and heavy loads all day on rough outdoor surfaces. This class spans roughly 26,000 to 36,000 lb of rated capacity at a 36-inch load center.
26k-36k-heavy-forklift.configNote: Specs are OEM base-unit figures; actual units vary with mast, forks, attachments and options. As a grouped range listing, capacity, height and weight reflect several models across the 26,000-36,000 lb class; representative figures are from the Hyster H360-36HD.
26k-36k-heavy-forklift.coversNote: Covers Hyster H260XD through H360XD / H300-360XD-series heavy-duty pneumatic-tire forklifts (26,000-36,000 lb). Representative specs from the H360-36HD (36,000 lb @ 36 in).
26k-36k-heavy-forklift.source: RitchieSpecs Hyster H360-36HD (https://www.ritchiespecs.com/model/hyster-h360-36hd-forklift); Hyster H300-360XD product page (https://www.hyster.com/en-us/north-america/high-capacity-internal-combustion-trucks-pneumatic-tire/h210-250xd48-h300-360xd/)

60-120k-lb-heavy-forklift.overview: American-built big-truck pneumatic forklifts for handling steel coils, pipe, concrete and other extreme loads. Powered by high-output Cummins diesels through 3-speed Dana automatic powershift transmissions and load-sensing hydraulics. This class runs from 60,000 lb (P600) up to about 110,000-120,000 lb (P1100) at a 48-inch load center.

rows.v: Diesel (optional GM 5.7L / 8.1L LP on some models)

rows.k: Length to Fork Face (P600 / P800 / P1100)

60-120k-lb-heavy-forklift.configNote: Specs are OEM base-unit figures; actual units vary with capacity, mast, attachments and options. As a grouped range listing, values span multiple P-Series models across the 60,000-120,000 lb class; engine power, dimensions and weights scale with capacity. Service weight not published per model.
60-120k-lb-heavy-forklift.coversNote: Covers Hoist Liftruck P-Series and comparable Brute-class big-truck pneumatic forklifts, 60,000-120,000 lb (P600 through P1100). Representative dimensions span the P600, P800 and P1100.
60-120k-lb-heavy-forklift.source: Hoist P-Series basic-specs sheet (https://otaysales.s3.amazonaws.com/item/spec_file/1664/Hoist-P-Series.pdf); Hoist P-Series brochure via Doggett (https://www.doggett.com/images/doggett-toyotalift/brands-equipment/09_Hoist/01_Pneumatic/01_P-Series/Hoist_P-Series_Brochure.pdf); Hoist Material Handling P-Series (https://www.hoistlift.com/p-series-22-000-125-000-lbs-/)

15k-17-5-heavy-forklifts.overview: Rugged internal-combustion pneumatic-tire forklifts built for heavy, high-cycle outdoor work at lumberyards, block plants and freight docks. Diesel power with a load-sensing hydraulic mast delivers strong lift and long fork heights. This class covers roughly 15,000 to 17,500 lb rated capacity at a 24-inch load center.
15k-17-5-heavy-forklifts.configNote: Specs are OEM base-unit figures; actual units vary with mast, forks, tires, fuel type and options. As a grouped range listing, capacity and height reflect several models across the 15,000-17,500 lb class; representative figures are from the Hyster H155FT diesel.
15k-17-5-heavy-forklifts.coversNote: Covers Hyster H135FT through H170-class pneumatic-tire forklifts (15,000-17,500 lb). Representative specs from the H155FT diesel (15,500 lb @ 24 in).
15k-17-5-heavy-forklifts.source: RitchieSpecs Hyster H155FT Diesel (https://www.ritchiespecs.com/model/hyster-h155ft-diesel-forklift); Hyster H135-155FT product page (https://www.hyster.com/en-us/north-america/internal-combustion-trucks/h135-155ft/)

40k-50k-heavy-forklifts.overview: Purpose-built heavy-duty pneumatic forklifts for long-duty-cycle handling of steel, pipe, precast concrete and oversized loads. A Cummins QSL9 diesel drives a Dana powershift transmission and AxleTech planetary drive axle through an ULTRA-VU high-visibility mast. This class covers roughly 40,000 to 50,000 lb rated capacity at a 36-inch load center.
40k-50k-heavy-forklifts.configNote: Specs are OEM base-unit figures; actual units vary with mast, forks, attachments and options. As a grouped range listing, capacity reflects several models across the 40,000-50,000 lb class; representative figures are from the Taylor X-450M. Service weight not published per model.
40k-50k-heavy-forklifts.coversNote: Covers Taylor X-/XH-450M through X-500M heavy-duty pneumatic forklifts (40,000-50,000 lb). Representative specs from the X-450M (45,000 lb @ 36 in).
40k-50k-heavy-forklifts.source: Taylor X-450M product page (https://www.taylorforklifts.com/product.php?model=X-450M); Taylor International X-450M (https://www.taylorintl.com/product.php?model=X-450M)

18k-25k-heavy-forklifts.overview: High-capacity outdoor diesel forklifts for lumber, concrete and heavy cargo handling, with strong maneuverability and support for tire handlers, paper-roll and concrete clamps. Cummins power, ZF powershift transmission and pneumatic tires deliver stable lifting on rough yards. This class covers roughly 18,000 to 25,000 lb rated capacity at a 24-inch load center.
18k-25k-heavy-forklifts.configNote: Specs are OEM base-unit figures; actual units vary with mast, forks, attachments, engine tier and options. As a grouped range listing, capacity, height and weight reflect several models across the 18,000-25,000 lb class; representative figures are from the Yale GDP210DF.
18k-25k-heavy-forklifts.coversNote: Covers Yale GDP190-250DF and comparable Toyota THD-series pneumatic forklifts (18,000-25,000 lb). Representative specs from the Yale GDP210DF (21,000 lb @ 24 in).
18k-25k-heavy-forklifts.source: Yale GDP190-280DF spec sheet (https://www.yale.com/globalassets/coms/yale/north-america/documents/trucks/high-capacity-pneumatic/gdp190-280df-spec-sheet.pdf); Yale GP190-280DF product page (https://yale.com/en-us/north-america/high-capacity-internal-combustion-trucks-pneumatic-tire/gp190-280df)

8k-40-49ft-telehandlers.overview: A full-size 8,000 lb rough-terrain telehandler for lifting and placing loads at height on job sites and yards. This class reaches roughly 42-44 ft with strong mid-range capacity, and runs full-time four-wheel drive with multiple steer modes for tight, uneven ground. Ideal for framing, masonry, roofing and general material staging.
8k-40-49ft-telehandlers.coversNote: Covers Genie GTH-844, JLG 8042, SkyTrak 8042, Xtreme XR842 and Gehl RS8-42 class machines (8,000 lb capacity, ~42-44 ft lift height). Ranges span these models; engine and dimension rows reflect the representative Genie GTH-844.
8k-40-49ft-telehandlers.configNote: Specs are OEM base-unit figures for the representative model and reflect a range across several 8k / 40-49 ft models; the actual unit may vary with options and attachments (forks, carriage, bucket, etc.).
8k-40-49ft-telehandlers.source: Genie GTH-844 spec sheet (genielift.com); RitchieSpecs Genie GTH844 (https://www.ritchiespecs.com/model/genie-gth844-telescopic-forklift); Conger Genie GTH-844 (https://www.conger.com/product/genie-gth-844-telehandler/).

10-12k-50ft-telehandlers.overview: A high-capacity rough-terrain telehandler class that lifts 10,000-12,000 lb to about 54-56 ft, the tallest and strongest telehandlers in a typical rental fleet. Built for structural steel, precast, heavy masonry and high-rise material placement, with load-sensing hydraulics and powershift drive. Outriggers are used to reach full capacity at maximum height and reach.
10-12k-50ft-telehandlers.coversNote: Covers JLG 1055 / 1255, SkyTrak 10054 / 12054 and JCB 510-56 / 512-56 class machines (10,000-12,000 lb capacity, ~54-56 ft lift height). Ranges span these models; engine and dimension rows reflect the representative JLG 1055.
10-12k-50ft-telehandlers.configNote: Specs are OEM base-unit figures for the representative model and reflect a range across several 10-12k / 50 ft+ models; the actual unit may vary with options and attachments. Full capacity at maximum height/reach requires outriggers.

6-7k-42ft-telehandlers.overview: A versatile mid-size rough-terrain telehandler class rated 6,000-7,000 lb with about 42 ft of lift height. These are among the most common general-purpose telehandlers on a job site, pairing hydrostatic drive and full-time four-wheel drive for smooth control on rough ground. Well suited to residential and commercial framing, masonry and material handling.
6-7k-42ft-telehandlers.coversNote: Covers JLG 642 / 742, SkyTrak 6042 / 7042 and Xtreme XR642 class machines (6,000-7,000 lb capacity, ~42 ft lift height). Ranges span these models; engine and dimension rows reflect the representative SkyTrak 6042.
6-7k-42ft-telehandlers.configNote: Specs are OEM base-unit figures for the representative model and reflect a range across several 6-7k / 42 ft models; the actual unit may vary with options and attachments.
6-7k-42ft-telehandlers.source: SkyTrak 6042 (jlg.com); RitchieSpecs SkyTrak 6042 (https://www.ritchiespecs.com/model/skytrak-6042-telescopic-forklift); SkyTrak 6042 spec sheet (sunbeltrentals.com).

9k-40-49ft-telehandlers.overview: A heavy-duty 9,000 lb rough-terrain telehandler reaching about 43 ft, bridging the gap between standard 8k machines and high-capacity units. It carries strong capacity deep into its lift range - 7,000 lb still available at full height - making it a workhorse for masonry, steel and heavy material placement. Powershift drive and selectable steer modes handle demanding job-site ground.
9k-40-49ft-telehandlers.coversNote: Covers JLG 943 and Lull 944E-42 class machines (9,000 lb capacity, ~42-43 ft lift height). Engine and dimension rows reflect the representative JLG 943.
9k-40-49ft-telehandlers.configNote: Specs are OEM base-unit figures for the representative JLG 943 and reflect a range across 9k / 40-49 ft models; the actual unit may vary with options and attachments.
9k-40-49ft-telehandlers.source: JLG 943 (jlg.com); RitchieSpecs JLG 943 (https://www.ritchiespecs.com/model/jlg-943-telescopic-forklift); JLG 943 spec sheet (acropolis-wp-content-uploads, s3-us-west-1.amazonaws.com).

6k-36ft-telehandlers.overview: A compact 6,000 lb rough-terrain telehandler reaching 36 ft, engineered to stay under 20,000 lb for easier transport while retaining full-size lifting muscle. Full-time four-wheel drive and a tight turning radius make it maneuverable in confined job sites, and it can pick and carry its full 6,000 lb capacity. A practical all-around choice for framing, roofing and material staging.
6k-36ft-telehandlers.coversNote: Single-model class - the Genie GTH-636, Genie's compact 6,000 lb / 36 ft full-size telehandler.
6k-36ft-telehandlers.configNote: Specs are OEM base-unit figures for the Genie GTH-636; the actual unit may vary with options and attachments (forks, carriage, bucket, etc.). Operating weight reflects the current-generation model kept under 20,000 lb.
6k-36ft-telehandlers.source: Genie GTH-636 spec sheet (genielift.com); RitchieSpecs Genie GTH636 (https://www.ritchiespecs.com/model/genie-gth636-telescopic-forklift); Lift and Access, 'Genie's New 6000-lb Telehandler' (liftandaccess.com).

60ft-telescopic-boom-lifts.overview: A 60 ft self-propelled straight (telescopic) boom lift for high-reach exterior work such as steel erection, painting, and building maintenance. Delivers roughly 66 ft of working height with strong horizontal outreach and a rough-terrain 4WD chassis, plus a jib on most models for precise final positioning.
60ft-telescopic-boom-lifts.coversNote: Covers Genie S-60 / S-65 and Skyjack SJ63 AJ / SJ66 T class 60 ft telescopic (straight) boom lifts. Height, reach, and capacity are presented as ranges across these models.
60ft-telescopic-boom-lifts.configNote: Specifications are OEM base-unit figures for representative 60 ft telescopic booms; because this is a grouped listing, values are ranges reflecting several models. The actual delivered unit may vary by manufacturer, model year, engine, and options/attachments.
60ft-telescopic-boom-lifts.source: Genie S-60 J product page (genielift.com/en/aerial-lifts/telescopic-boom-lifts/s60j); RitchieSpecs Genie S60 (ritchiespecs.com/model/genie-s60-boom-lift); Conger Genie S-60 listing (conger.com/product/genie-s60-boom-lift).

85ft-telescopic-boom-lifts.overview: An 85 ft self-propelled telescopic boom lift built for tall exterior access work where reach and up-high capacity both matter. Provides about 91 ft of working height and roughly 75 ft of horizontal outreach, with XC (Xtra Capacity) models carrying up to 1,000 lb for two workers plus tools and materials.

rows.v: 500 lb unrestricted / up to 1,000 lb restricted (XC)

85ft-telescopic-boom-lifts.coversNote: Covers Genie S-80 / S-85 (including XC and HF variants) and Snorkel A80 / TB85J class 80-85 ft telescopic boom lifts. Height, reach, and capacity are presented as ranges across these models.
85ft-telescopic-boom-lifts.configNote: Specifications are OEM base-unit figures for representative 85 ft telescopic booms; because this is a grouped listing, values are ranges reflecting several models. The actual delivered unit may vary by manufacturer, model year, engine, and options/attachments.
85ft-telescopic-boom-lifts.source: Genie S-85 XC product page (genielift.com/en/aerial-lifts/telescopic-boom-lifts/s-85-xcen); RitchieSpecs Genie S85 (ritchiespecs.com/model/genie-s85-boom-lift); Conger Genie S-85 listing (conger.com/product/genie-s85-boom-lift).

80ft-articulating-lifts.overview: An 80 ft articulating (knuckle) boom lift for high work that has to reach up and over obstacles rather than straight out. The multi-section articulating arm gives about 84 ft working height, 60 ft of horizontal reach, and roughly 29 ft of up-and-over clearance, with a 360-degree continuous-rotation turntable for positioning in tight spots.

rows.v: Deutz TD2011 L04i diesel (Perkins / Continental gas-LPG optional)

80ft-articulating-lifts.coversNote: Covers Genie Z-80/60 class 80 ft wheeled articulating boom lifts (Deutz, Perkins, and gas/LPG engine variants). Height, reach, and capacity are presented as ranges across these configurations.
80ft-articulating-lifts.configNote: Specifications are OEM base-unit figures for the representative Genie Z-80/60; because this is a grouped listing, values are ranges reflecting several engine/drive configurations. The actual delivered unit may vary by model year, engine, and options/attachments.
80ft-articulating-lifts.source: Genie Z-80/60 product page (genielift.com/en/aerial-lifts/articulated-boom-lifts/z8060); RitchieSpecs Genie Z80/60 (ritchiespecs.com/model/genie-z80-60-boom-lift).

30ft-boom-lift.overview: A compact 30 ft electric articulating boom lift designed for indoor and tight-space work with zero emissions and quiet operation. Its narrow 4 ft width, zero tail swing, and up-and-over articulation let it reach over machinery and into confined areas that a straight boom cannot, making it ideal for maintenance, electrical, and finishing work.
30ft-boom-lift.configNote: Specifications are OEM base-unit figures for the JLG E300AJP; the actual delivered unit may vary by model year and options/attachments (e.g., platform size, tires).
30ft-boom-lift.source: JLG E300AJP product page (jlg.com/en-gb/equipment/boom-lifts/articulating/electric-hybrid/e300-series/e300ajp); RitchieSpecs JLG E300AJP (ritchiespecs.com/model/jlg-e300ajp-boom-lift).

46ft-articulating-boom-lift.overview: A 46 ft rough-terrain articulating boom lift with axle-based 4WD for outdoor jobsite access over uneven ground. The multi-jointed boom and 5 ft jib provide strong up-and-over clearance and horizontal outreach, letting crews position the platform around obstacles for construction, maintenance, and industrial work.

rows.v: Deutz D2.9L4 diesel (Kubota WG2503 dual-fuel optional)

46ft-articulating-boom-lift.configNote: Specifications are OEM base-unit figures for the Skyjack SJ46 AJ; the actual delivered unit may vary by model year, engine (diesel vs. dual-fuel), and options/attachments. Platform capacity varies between unrestricted and restricted ratings.
46ft-articulating-boom-lift.source: Skyjack SJ46 AJ spec sheet (skyjack.com/sites/default/files/literature-library/SJ46_AJ.pdf); RitchieSpecs Skyjack SJ46 AJ (ritchiespecs.com/model/skyjack-sj46-aj-boom-lift).

case-1021f-wheel-loader-with-rockland-lo.overview: The Case 1021F is a full-size production wheel loader built for high-volume loading of aggregate, sand, and heavy material. This unit is fitted with a Rockland log clamp in place of a bucket, making it purpose-built for grabbing, lifting, and stacking logs and bulky debris. With a 262 hp engine and over 45,000 lb of breakout force, it delivers strong cycle times in demanding yard and forestry work.

rows.v: Rockland log clamp (in place of standard bucket)

case-1021f-wheel-loader-with-rockland-lo.configNote: Specifications are OEM base-unit figures for the Case 1021F; bucket capacity, breakout, tipping load, and dump/reach dimensions reflect the standard Z-bar bucket configuration. This unit is equipped with a Rockland log clamp attachment, which changes handling capacity, reach, and weight from the base bucket figures. Actual unit may vary with options and attachments.
case-1021f-wheel-loader-with-rockland-lo.attachmentsNote: Fitted with a Rockland log clamp for log and bulk-material handling.
case-1021f-wheel-loader-with-rockland-lo.source: RitchieSpecs (https://www.ritchiespecs.com/model/case-1021f-wheel-loader); Construction Equipment Guide (https://www.constructionequipmentguide.com/charts/wheel-loaders/case/1021f/39347); CASE Construction Equipment product data.

case-721g-wheel-loader.overview: The Case 721G is a versatile mid-size wheel loader well suited to aggregate yards, site development, roadwork, and municipal loading. It pairs a 179 hp FPT diesel with a powershift transmission and a roughly 3.3-yard bucket for efficient truck loading and stockpiling. Strong breakout force and good visibility make it a productive all-around production loader.

rows.k: Max Reach at Full Lift & Dump

case-721g-wheel-loader.configNote: Specifications are OEM base-unit figures for the Case 721G with the standard bucket. Actual unit may vary with bucket type, options, and attachments.
case-721g-wheel-loader.source: RitchieSpecs (https://www.ritchiespecs.com/model/case-721g-wheel-loader); CASE Construction Equipment (https://www.casece.com/en-us/northamerica/products/wheel-loaders/large-wheel-loaders/721g); Construction Equipment Guide (https://www.constructionequipmentguide.com/charts/wheel-loaders/case/721g/30703828).

john-deere-444k-wheel-loader-2y-bucket.overview: The John Deere 444K is a compact-to-mid production wheel loader ideal for landscaping, small aggregate work, snow handling, and general site loading. Configured here with an approximately 2-yard bucket, it offers nimble maneuverability, good breakout for its class, and low operating costs. A PowerTech diesel and powershift transmission keep cycles quick and fuel use efficient.
john-deere-444k-wheel-loader-2y-bucket.configNote: Specifications are OEM base-unit figures for the John Deere 444K. Bucket capacity varies with configuration; this listing is fitted with an approximately 2-yard bucket, while Deere offers 2.49-4.06 yd3 options. Actual unit may vary with options and attachments.
john-deere-444k-wheel-loader-2y-bucket.source: RitchieSpecs (https://www.ritchiespecs.com/model/john-deere-444k-wheel-loader); Construction Equipment Guide (https://www.constructionequipmentguide.com/charts/wheel-loaders/john-deere/444k/18551); John Deere product data.

volvo-l70h-wheel-loader.overview: The Volvo L70H is a fuel-efficient mid-size wheel loader known for strong lifting stability and operator comfort. Its H-Series Torque Parallel linkage keeps loads level through the full lift range while delivering high breakout and tear-out forces. At about 170 hp with a roughly 2.4-yard bucket, it is well matched to aggregate loading, material rehandling, and general construction.
volvo-l70h-wheel-loader.configNote: Specifications are OEM base-unit figures for the Volvo L70H. Operating weight, bucket capacity, tipping load, and dump clearance vary with bucket selection and options; figures shown reflect a typical general-purpose bucket configuration. Actual unit may vary with options and attachments.
volvo-l70h-wheel-loader.source: RitchieSpecs (https://www.ritchiespecs.com/model/volvo-l70h-wheel-loader); Volvo Construction Equipment (https://www.volvoce.com/united-states/en-us/products/wheel-loaders/l70h/); Volvo L70H product guide brochure.

5-8k-forklifts.overview: The 5,000-8,000 lb forklift class covers sit-down counterbalanced trucks from Toyota and Yale used for general warehouse, dock, and yard material handling. Cushion-tire units run indoors on smooth floors while pneumatic-tire versions handle rougher outdoor surfaces, and most are offered in LP gas, gasoline, or diesel. Three-stage masts reach roughly 199 in to stack loads up to four tons.
5-8k-forklifts.coversNote: Covers Toyota 8FGCU25/8FGU30 and Yale GC050VX-GLC070VX class cushion trucks plus 8,000 lb pneumatic units (e.g. Toyota 8FG35U); 5,000-8,000 lb capacity.
5-8k-forklifts.configNote: Specs are OEM base-unit figures; the actual unit may vary with mast, tire type, and attachments. Ranges reflect several models across the 5,000-8,000 lb class; the 8FGCU25 is shown as the representative unit.

3k-4k-forklifts.overview: The 3,000-4,000 lb forklift class covers compact sit-down counterbalanced trucks from Yale, Toyota, and Hyster built for tight-aisle indoor warehousing and light dock work. Their short wheelbase and roughly 70 in turning radius make them highly maneuverable, while three-stage masts lift to about 189 in. Most run on LP gas or gasoline with cushion tires for smooth-floor operation.

john-deere-550k-crawler-bulldozer.overview: The John Deere 550K is a compact-to-mid-size hydrostatic crawler dozer built for grading, backfilling, site prep, and finish dozing on residential and light-commercial jobs. Its ~92 hp Tier 4 Final PowerTech engine and dual-path hydrostatic drive deliver smooth, precise blade control and full counter-rotation in tight areas. A low ground pressure and six-way PAT blade make it a versatile all-around dozer for contractors.
john-deere-550k-crawler-bulldozer.configNote: Specifications are OEM base-unit figures for the John Deere 550K (Tier 4 Final). The actual unit may vary with blade choice, track shoe width, and installed options.

cat-d6k2-bulldozer.overview: The Cat D6K2 is a mid-size medium dozer built for dozing, grading, spreading, and finish work on commercial site development, road building, and landscaping. With ~130 hp and available VPAT (six-way) blades up to 4.38 yd3, it pairs strong production with fine grade accuracy. Low ground pressure LGP undercarriage options and available Cat GRADE technology make it a productive choice for a wide range of earthmoving jobs.

19ft-scissor-lift.overview: The Genie GS-1930 is a compact self-propelled electric scissor lift that reaches a 25 ft working height while fitting through a standard doorway at just 2 ft 6 in wide. Its non-marking tires and zero-emission drive make it ideal for indoor construction, maintenance, and installation work on finished floors. A 36 in roll-out deck extension adds reach without moving the machine.
